// Volatility-Compression Release Coil Model
// ATR + range coil + vol-of-vol + tape predictability, release-gated. No dashboard.

atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLen = input(50, "Coil Lookback", 10, 150, 1)
rangeLen = input(20, "Range Coil Lookback", 5, 100, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "VoV Lookback", 5, 60, 1)
predLen = input(20, "Predictability Lookback", 5, 60, 1)
coilThresh = input(80.0, "Coil Load Threshold", 10.0, 100.0, 1.0)
vovRiseThresh = input(0.0, "VoV Rise Threshold", 0.0, 0.05, 0.005)
relAtrMult = input(1.2, "Release ATR Mult", 1.0, 3.0, 0.1)
relRangeMult = input(1.5, "Release Range Mult", 1.0, 4.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tr1 = high - low
tr2 = abs(high - close[1])
tr3 = abs(low - close[1])
trueRange = max(tr1, tr2)
trueRange = max(trueRange, tr3)
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rngNow = high - low
rngMax = highest(rngNow, rangeLen)
rngLow = lowest(rngNow, rangeLen)
rangeRatio = rngNow / max(rngMax, 0.000000001)
atrLow = lowest(atrVal, coilLen)
atrHigh = highest(atrVal, coilLen)
atrSpan = atrHigh - atrLow
coilLoad = 100 * (1 - (atrVal - atrLow) / max(atrSpan, 0.000000001))
atrPrev = atrVal[1]
atrChg = (atrVal - atrPrev) / max(atrPrev, 0.000000001)
volOfVol = stdev(atrChg, vovLen)
volPrev = volOfVol[1]
vovRising = volOfVol - volPrev > vovRiseThresh
moveAbs = abs(close - close[predLen])
sumRange = sma(rngNow, predLen) * predLen
predict = 100 * moveAbs / max(sumRange, 0.000000001)
compression = coilLoad >= coilThresh and rangeRatio < 0.5 and vovRising
compRecent = compression or compression[1] or compression[2] or compression[3] or compression[4] or compression[5]
rangeExpand = rngNow > relRangeMult * rngLow
atrExpand = atrVal > relAtrMult * atrPrev
buyRaw = compRecent and rangeExpand and atrExpand and close > open
sellRaw = compRecent and rangeExpand and atrExpand and close < open

var relLock = 0.0
if compression {
  relLock := 0.0
}
buyRelease = buyRaw and not buyRaw[1] and relLock[1] == 0.0
sellRelease = sellRaw and not sellRaw[1] and relLock[1] == 0.0 and not buyRelease
if buyRelease or sellRelease {
  relLock := 1.0
}

vovPlot = volOfVol * 1000
comboHeight = coilLoad * predict / 100

if buyRelease { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if sellRelease { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if buyRelease { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "separate") }
if sellRelease { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "separate") }

plot(coilLoad, "Coil Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(predict, "Predictability", "#ff8c42", 2, "separate")
plot(rangeRatio * 100, "Range Ratio x100", "#8a93a6", 1, "separate")
plot3d(coilLoad, "Coil Load X", "ribbon", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predict, "Predictability Y", "scatter", "#ff8c42", "separate", 1)
plot3d(vovPlot, "Vol-of-Vol Z", "scatter", "#b48cff", "separate", 2)

// Multi-Timeframe Siege Model
// Session range extremes + confirmed 1h structure + quality confidence + hard stop

sessLen = input(20, "Session Length (bars)", 10, 200, 1)
swLb = input(2, "1h Confirmation Lookback (swings)", 1, 10, 1)
confBars = input(2, "Structure Confirmation Bars", 1, 10, 1)
minDisp = input(5.0, "Min Structure Displacement (points)", 0.5, 100.0, 0.5)
confThresh = input(60, "Confidence Threshold", 0, 100, 1)
stopDist = input(10.0, "Hard Stop Distance (points)", 1.0, 200.0, 0.5)

htfClose = security("1h", close)
htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)

sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)

winLen = swLb * 2 + 1
swingHighCand = htfHigh[swLb]
swingLowCand = htfLow[swLb]
windowHigh = highest(htfHigh, winLen)
windowLow = lowest(htfLow, winLen)
isSwingHighNow = swingHighCand >= windowHigh and windowHigh > 0
isSwingLowNow = swingLowCand <= windowLow and swingLowCand > 0

var lastSwingHigh = 0.0
var lastSwingLow = 0.0
var bullHold = 0.0
var bearHold = 0.0

if isSwingHighNow {
    lastSwingHigh := swingHighCand
}
if isSwingLowNow {
    lastSwingLow := swingLowCand
}

aboveHigh = htfClose > lastSwingHigh and lastSwingHigh > 0
belowLow = htfClose < lastSwingLow and lastSwingLow > 0

if aboveHigh {
    bullHold := bullHold[1] + 1
} else {
    bullHold := 0
}
if belowLow {
    bearHold := bearHold[1] + 1
} else {
    bearHold := 0
}

isBull = bullHold >= confBars
isBear = bearHold >= confBars

structDir = isBull and not isBear ? 1 : isBear and not isBull ? -1 : 0
bullDisp = htfClose - lastSwingHigh
bearDisp = lastSwingLow - htfClose
structDisp = structDir == 1 ? bullDisp : structDir == -1 ? bearDisp : 0
bullExtend = htfClose > htfClose[1]
bearExtend = htfClose < htfClose[1]
extendOk = structDir == 1 and bullExtend ? true : structDir == -1 and bearExtend ? true : false
quality = (structDir != 0 ? 50 : 0) + (structDisp >= minDisp ? 25 : 0) + (extendOk ? 25 : 0)

buySig = crossover(close, sessHigh[1]) and structDir == 1 and quality >= confThresh
sellSig = crossunder(close, sessLow[1]) and structDir == -1 and quality >= confThresh

if buySig {
    model.confidence(quality / 100)
    model.stopLoss(stopDist, "abs")
    model.longEntry("siege")
    model.shortExit("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(quality / 100)
    model.stopLoss(stopDist, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("siege")
    model.longExit("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}

plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

lookback = input(80, "Lookback Length", 10, 300, 1)
f236 = input(0.236, "Fib 23.6%", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
f382 = input(0.382, "Fib 38.2%", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
f50 = input(0.5, "Fib 50%", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
f618 = input(0.618, "Fib 61.8%", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

swingHigh = highest(high, lookback)
swingLow = lowest(low, lookback)
rng = swingHigh - swingLow

lev236 = swingLow + rng * f236
lev382 = swingLow + rng * f382
lev50 = swingLow + rng * f50
lev618 = swingLow + rng * f618

var lastDir = 0
var evtBar = 0
var evtPrice = 0.0

buySig = crossover(close, lev618)
sellSig = crossunder(close, lev382)

if barstate.isconfirmed and buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 3, "3d")
    text.new(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "fibEvent")
    lastDir := 1
    evtBar := bar_index
    evtPrice := lev618
}
if barstate.isconfirmed and sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
    text.new(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "#ff4477", 1, "fibEvent")
    lastDir := -1
    evtBar := bar_index
    evtPrice := lev382
}

plot(lev236, "23.6%", "#00ccff", 1, "stepline")
plot(lev382, "38.2%", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")
plot(lev50, "50%", "#b48cff", 1, "stepline")
plot(lev618, "61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

plot3d(lev236, "Fib 23.6%", "line3d", "#00ccff", "3d", 0)
plot3d(lev382, "Fib 38.2%", "line3d", "#ffcc00", "3d", 1)
plot3d(lev50, "Fib 50%", "line3d", "#b48cff", "3d", 2)
plot3d(lev618, "Fib 61.8%", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 3)

fastLen = input(10, "Fast Vol Length", 5, 20, 1)
medLen = input(30, "Medium Vol Length", 20, 50, 1)
slowLen = input(60, "Slow Vol Length", 40, 100, 1)
skewLen = input(60, "Skew Range Length", 20, 120, 1)
compLb = input(50, "Compression Lookback", 20, 100, 1)
expMult = input(1.15, "Expansion Mult", 1.02, 2.0, 0.01)
bullLvl = input(0.2, "Skew Bull Level", -1.0, 1.0, 0.05)
bearLvl = input(-0.2, "Skew Bear Level", -1.0, 1.0, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

ret = (close - close[1]) / (abs(close[1]) + 0.00001)
fastVol = stdev(ret, fastLen) * sqrt(fastLen)
medVol = stdev(ret, medLen) * sqrt(medLen)
slowVol = stdev(ret, slowLen) * sqrt(slowLen)
rollHigh = highest(high, skewLen)
rollLow = lowest(low, skewLen)
rng = rollHigh - rollLow
skewRaw = ((close - rollLow) / (rng + 0.00001) - 0.5) * 2.0
skew = rng < 0.00001 ? 0 : skewRaw
spread = fastVol - slowVol
midSpread = fastVol - medVol
compLow = lowest(fastVol, compLb)
compressed = fastVol <= compLow * 1.02
expanded = fastVol[1] <= compLow[1] * 1.02 and fastVol > fastVol[1] * expMult and fastVol > medVol
expRecent = expanded or expanded[1] or expanded[2]
skewCrossUp = skew[1] <= bullLvl and skew > bullLvl
skewCrossDn = skew[1] >= bearLvl and skew < bearLvl
spreadUp = spread > spread[1] and spread[1] < 0
spreadDn = spread < spread[1] and spread[1] > 0
warm = bar_index > slowLen

var lastBuy = 0
var lastSell = 0
coolBuy = bar_index - lastBuy > compLb
coolSell = bar_index - lastSell > compLb
buySig = warm and expRecent and skewCrossUp and spreadUp and coolBuy
sellSig = warm and expRecent and skewCrossDn and spreadDn and coolSell

if buySig {
  lastBuy := bar_index
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
  lastSell := bar_index
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "separate")
}

bgcolor(compressed ? "#1a2a3a" : "#00000000")
plot(spread, "Spread F-S", "#ffcc33", 1, "separate")
plot(midSpread, "MidSpread F-M", "#4488ff", 1, "separate")
plot(skew, "Skew", "#22cc88", 1, "separate")
hline(0, "#888888")
hline(bullLvl, "#22cc88")
hline(bearLvl, "#ff4477")
avgVol = (fastVol + medVol + slowVol) / 3.0
fastImp = fastVol * (1.5 + skew)
plot3d(avgVol, "Term Structure", "manifold", "#22cc88", "separate", 0)
plot3d(fastVol, "Fast Spine", "ribbon", "#ffcc33", "separate", 1)
plot3d(fastImp, "Skew Impulse", "bars3d", "#4488ff", "separate", 2)

ch2 = input(40, "Ch2 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch3 = input(60, "Ch3 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch4 = input(80, "Ch4 Strength", 0, 100, 1)

maxScale = input(100, "Max Scale", 10, 200, 1)

c1raw = ch1 + wob

windX = input(1.0, "Wind Dir X", -1.0, 1.0, 0.1)
windY = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Y", -1.0, 1.0, 0.1)
windZ = input(0.0, "Wind Dir Z", -1.0, 1.0, 0.1)
wind_speed_knots = input(10.0, "Wind Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 0.5)
min_speed_knots = input(0.0, "Min Speed Knots", 0.0, 20.0, 0.5)
max_speed_knots = input(50.0, "Max Speed Knots", 10.0, 100.0, 1.0)
base_tail_length = input(1.0, "Base Tail Length", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)
length_per_knot = input(0.1, "Length Per Knot", 0.01, 0.5, 0.01)
high_wind_alert_knots = input(35.0, "High Wind Alert Knots", 10.0, 80.0, 1.0)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

drift = (close - open) * 0.2
wob = (close - close[1]) * 0.05
effSpeed = wind_speed_knots + drift + wob
effX = windX + (close - open) / (close + 0.000001) * 0.5
effY = windY + (high - low) / (close + 0.000001) * 0.3
effZ = windZ + (close - close[1]) / (close + 0.000001) * 0.5

mag = sqrt(effX * effX + effY * effY + effZ * effZ)

var prevUx = 1.0
var prevUy = 0.0
var prevUz = 0.0

uxRaw = effX / (mag + 0.000001)
uyRaw = effY / (mag + 0.000001)
uzRaw = effZ / (mag + 0.000001)

isZero = mag < 0.000001
ux = isZero and prevUx or uxRaw
uy = isZero and prevUy or uyRaw
uz = isZero and prevUz or uzRaw

horiz = sqrt(effX * effX + effY * effY)
yawRad = atan2(effY, effX)
pitchRad = atan2(effZ, horiz + 0.000001)
yawDeg = yawRad * 57.2958
pitchDeg = pitchRad * 57.2958
rollDeg = 0.0

tailLen = base_tail_length + length_per_knot * effSpeed
span = max_speed_knots - min_speed_knots + 0.000001
speedRaw = (effSpeed - min_speed_knots) / span
speedLow = speedRaw < 0.0 and 0.0 or speedRaw
speed_norm = speedLow > 1.0 and 1.0 or speedLow

dotProd = ux * prevUx + uy * prevUy + uz * prevUz

calmLevel = min_speed_knots + 2.0
highState = effSpeed > high_wind_alert_knots
calmState = effSpeed < calmLevel
shiftState = dotProd < 0.0
highSig = highState and not highState[1]
calmSig = calmState and not calmState[1]
shiftSig = shiftState and not shiftState[1]

if highSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "HighWind", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if calmSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Calm", "triangleup", "#3388ff")
}
if shiftSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Shift", "triangledown", "#ff8800")
}
if highSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, effSpeed, "HighWind", "conedown", "#ff4477", tailLen * markerSize, 0, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
if calmSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, effSpeed, "Calm", "coneup", "#3388ff", tailLen * markerSize, 1, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
if shiftSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, effSpeed, "Shift", "diamond", "#ff8800", 1.0 * markerSize, 2, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
if not isZero {
    prevUx := ux
    prevUy := uy
    prevUz := uz
}

plot(effSpeed, "Wind Speed", "#3388ff", 1, "separate")
plot(tailLen, "Tail Length", "#ff8800", 1, "separate")
plot3d(tailLen, "Tail Length 3D", "ribbon", "#3388ff", "separate")
plot3d(effSpeed, "Speed 3D", "trail", "#ff8800", "separate", 1)
